brief: A technical 3D wireframe of a building's floor plan is displayed on a deep navy blue background. Thin white lines define structural walls, window openings, and staircases, accompanied by subtle grid lines and measurement markings. The camera orbits the schematic in a slow, continuous loop, offering a dynamic view of the architecture. Dragging the mouse rotates the entire structure, allowing for a detailed inspection of the geometric layout.

statement: This sketch presents a technical 3D visualization of an architectural floor plan rendered in real-time using p5.js's WEBGL mode. The scene features a structured building layout with defined walls, window openings, and a staircase, all displayed against a deep navy blue background to enhance contrast. The visualization continuously orbits to provide dynamic viewing angles while allowing user interaction through mouse dragging for detailed inspection. Grid lines and measurement markers add precision to the schematic representation, creating a clear technical drawing effect that emphasizes geometric relationships within the architectural space.
